records.name: Semos.ai Manager Agents
records.tagline: AI agents purpose-built for managers
records.description: Manager Agents learn from your meetings, then point you to what needs your attention next: the feedback that is overdue, the recognition you missed, the conflict you are avoiding, the growth talk that keeps slipping. You learn what works, what doesn't, and why, so you become better at leading your people.

records.name: iFixAi
records.tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
records.description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

records.name: ZenABM
records.tagline: Create, optimize & report on LinkedIn Ads from any AI tool
records.description: Ditch copy-pasting into Campaign Manager! Create, launch & optimize your LinkedIn Ad Campaigns from your favourite AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) with ZenABM’s MCP server or natively with our AI Agent Zena - both equipped with 20+ expert skills and 96 tools! +Automate your reporting (including company engagements & revenue attribution) with weekly & monthly reports produced by our AI Agents Zena.

records.name: Pokébinder
records.tagline: Plan your Pokémon binder, then print what's missing
records.description: A free binder planner for Pokémon TCG collectors. Search 40,000+ English and Japanese cards, arrange 3×3 pages, run your own art behind a whole page with cards on top, then print true-size placeholders for the cards you don't own yet. No account — your binder stays in your browser.

records.name: Engine Room Media
records.tagline: We Run The Numbers. You Run The Show.
records.description: Built for Creator growth, Engine Room brings all of your platform analytics, media kit, and rate cards together in one easy to use dashboard. Engine Room Media helps creators grow across all their favorite platforms (including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Patreon, Spotify, and Twitch) with data-driven insights, brand deals, and peer connections.

records.name: Paste 7
records.tagline: Intelligent clipboard that knows what you're about to paste
records.description: Intelligent Clipboard is new in Paste, the productivity app that remembers everything you copy. Paste now suggests which of your copied items you'll most likely paste next, based on what you're working on. Powered by Apple Intelligence, privately on your Mac.

records.name: ShipHappens:
records.tagline: ASO, keywords & screenshots for the app store
records.description: App Store Connect is slow, clunky, and buries everything that actually gets you downloads. ShipHappens is the native Mac app I built to fix that. Pick keywords using Apple's own search popularity data, make screenshots with AI, translate your listing into 39 languages in one go, A/B test your product page, and reply to reviews in any language. A feed across all your apps tells you what to fix next. Your key stays in your Keychain, and you can bring any AI provider or run a local model.

records.name: Timeful
records.tagline: Design web apps and sync with your own codebase
records.description: Timeful is a local-first visual editor that syncs with your codebase. Build your website or app on a visual canvas and Timeful instantly outputs clean, production-ready code for Vue, Nuxt, and Tailwind. All using predictable algorithms, without spending a single AI credit. Prefer coding? Edit the code and the canvas updates immediately via true two-way sync. You fully own the code: build in your own repository, review and merge changes, and deploy anywhere with zero vendor lock-in.

records.name: Codex Remote
records.tagline: Put Codex or Claude Code on your own cloud machine
records.description: Codex Remote is an open-source Mac menu bar app for putting Codex and Claude Code on a cloud machine you control. Choose a provider and size; it provisions the server with OpenTofu, installs the agents, and connects the machine to the apps you already use. See CPU, memory, and active sessions, pause idle servers, sync a project, or let an agent manage machines with opt-in MCP access. Your cloud credentials stay on your Mac. No hosted middleman. Independent of OpenAI and Anthropic.

records.name: Szept
records.tagline: Say it. Show it. Hand it to your agent.
records.description: Szept is a light, fast Mac app for talking to AI agents: dictate in 60+ languages, clean up text with AI, capture and record the screen, and hand it to Claude Code. Source code included.

records.name: Imejis.io
records.tagline: Give your agent a design studio to automate your marketing
records.description: Your AI agent writes the copy. With Imejis, it ships the image too. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI agents a design studio via MCP. Create, edit, preview, and render production-ready graphics. Build OG images, social cards, marketing graphics, charts, certificates, QR codes and more. Design once. Generate at scale. Unlike generative image models, Imejis is deterministic: the same input produces the same pixels, keeping your brand, layout, typography, and data consistent. Free to start

records.name: Arsaze
records.tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit your real timeline
records.description: Arsaze is the AI video editor for agents and humans — think Cursor for video editing. A real multi-track timeline that both you and an AI agent can drive over MCP or by talking to it, for AI video editing, AI video generation, and agent-driven video editing on one real timeline.

records.name: Timeless Code
records.tagline: Meeting notetaker that installs and runs inside Claude Code
records.description: An AI notetaker that lives inside Claude Code. Claude sets it up for you, and from then on you can record meetings and ask about anything that was said, right from your terminal.

records.name: Hopscotch AI
records.tagline: 500+ AI models available via a single API
records.description: 🎁 PRODUCT HUNT EXCLUSIVE: The first 250 PH users to sign up get $50 in free model credits. Create your free account and redeem code HOPSCOTCH50OFF in the Billing tab. | 🚀 Access 500+ AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more through one API. Use multiple providers without managing separate integrations, accounts, or payments. Compare models on your prompts, configure fallbacks, and track usage and spend in one place. Pay provider rates with no platform fees or token markup.

records.name: Curie
records.tagline: Assistant for scientific literature and document analysis.
records.description: Curie is an AI research assistant built for real scientific work, not a generalist chatbot. It searches PubMed, arXiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in parallel, then verifies every claim against the source text, so you see what's backed and what isn't. Point it at a document to extract structured data with the quote behind each value, or run a full systematic review, protocol, screening, PRISMA diagram, with you approving every decision. Projects and a library keep it organized.

records.name: LUCI Desktop
records.tagline: Let your AI agents remember what you've seen
records.description: Luci saves your screen history and meeting transcripts locally, so agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can help you find a page you forgot to bookmark or recall a decision from a call. Capture context across apps without setting up a connector for each one. Includes on-device transcription and daily summaries with Microsoft Foundry Local. Free for Mac and Windows.

records.name: Iris
records.tagline: AI agents built for your company’s operations
records.description: Iris integrates AI agents into the workflows and tools your company already uses. Agents coordinate work across teams, follow up through Slack and iMessage, update systems, and move recurring processes forward. Build agents for operations, GTM, sales, customer success, finance, recruiting, and more, with shared company context, custom workflows, and approval controls.

records.name: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude
records.tagline: Create, send, and sign documents in ChatGPT and Claude
records.description: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude brings document creation and e-signatures directly into your AI workspace. Create signature-ready documents from a prompt or uploaded file, edit content and signing fields, manage recipients and signing order, send documents for signature, and track their progress without switching tools. Existing Jotform Sign users can also access and manage their workflows right from ChatGPT or Claude.

records.name: Supertake
records.tagline: AI that turn your ideas into real investments
records.description: Supertake transforms your unique takes on the world into real, shareable investment portfolios using frontier AI and trading agents. Until now, we’ve invested at the mercy of financial managers, ETFs, and single stocks promoted by grifters and algorithms. But with Supertake you simply tell the agent what you believe in natural language and it creates a magical portfolio of assets and places the trades on your behalf. Supertake works with existing brokerages like Robinhood and Coinbase.

records.name: Enter Space 7
records.tagline: rclone for iPhone, iPad, Mac & TV — now with Finder mounts
records.description: Enter Space puts rclone's 70+ storage providers (S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, SFTP/NAS, WebDAV and more) inside the Files app, Finder and a full native app. Version 7 adds FSKit volume mounts on macOS 27, a Photos timeline and a film Theater that run on storage you own, and point-in-time backups with Time Portal. It also brings duplicate finding, Space Inspector and a code editor with git. Secrets stay in your Keychain and nothing is collected.

records.name: GroupShelf
records.tagline: Tabs for every window on your Mac
records.description: GroupShelf groups windows from any Mac app into tabs, like browser tabs for your whole desktop. Hold Shift and drag one window onto another to make or join a group. Move or resize one window and the whole group follows. Pull a tab off to split it again, color your tabs, name your groups. Native and lightweight, for macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon and Intel. $9.99 one-time, with a 30-day free trial of every feature.

records.name: Flotnote
records.tagline: Floating Markdown notes for Mac. Pay once, own your files
records.description: Flotnote is a Markdown notepad that floats above every app on your Mac. Hit one shortcut, write the thought down, and get back to work. Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose, so Obsidian and any other editor can open it right away. Full-text search, wiki-style links, tags, and several floating notes at once. No account, no servers, no subscription.

records.name: ColdIQ x Slack
records.tagline: Prompt GTM systems inside Slack
records.description: Prompt GTM systems inside Slack. Tag ColdIQ Bot and watch it build GTM systems for you. Your teammates can edit, reply and iterate directly in the thread. Discover what Slack looks like once you access: 40+ Data Providers without paying for each one. 100+ GTM skills that will help you book meetings. A database built on 5+ years of experience running GTM for 300+ teams. The easiest to go from text prompts to campaigns that generate revenue. Try it here: https://coldiq.com/slack

records.name: Ricly
records.tagline: Putting your most recurring tools in the right-click menu
records.description: Every small file task on a Mac ends in a browser tab: upload, wait, download, close. Ricly puts 17 of those tools in the Finder right-click menu: send big files as a link, find duplicates, merge PDFs, strip the location data out of a photo, pull the text out of an image, remove a background, upscale, convert, compress. They run on your Mac, and nothing is uploaded unless you deliberately share a file. One price instead of five single-purpose subscriptions.

records.name: ooon.ai
records.tagline: AI employee that answers, books, and reminds clients
records.description: Most booking tools wait for the client to open an app or fill a form. ooon.ai answers inside the chat the client already has open, in WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram, so no message goes unanswered. It explains prices and services, finds an open slot, books the client, sends a reminder before the visit, and reaches out to clients who stopped replying, around the clock, in Russian, Kazakh, or English. The owner gets one dashboard with every conversation, booking, and revenue total

records.name: Gladys Assistant 5
records.tagline: Private, self-hosted smart home, no YAML required
records.description: Gladys Assistant is a free, open-source smart home platform that runs on your own mini-PC or Raspberry Pi. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter and 90+ community integrations, a phone-first dashboard, no YAML, and it keeps working when the internet goes down.

records.name: Declutr
records.tagline: Tidy your Mac's desktop and downloads in one click
records.description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. One Undo puts every file back. New since the first launch: it's on the Mac App Store, with Smart Rules (name, extension, age, size), watched folders that sort new files as they land, and a daily cleanup. Rules, not AI: it never reads what's inside your files. Free to sort, Pro is $8.99 once.

records.name: GhostDeck
records.tagline: Offline Mac music player with living low-poly worlds
records.description: GhostDeck plays your own music files in the classic late-'90s deck layout, with a ten-band EQ and a playlist that snap together. Behind your album, a jewel case turns over one of five low-poly worlds that move to the music. Native Metal, offline, no tracking.

records.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
records.tagline: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family
records.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is Anthropic’s fast, cost-efficient AI model for everyday work: coding, bug fixes, documents, slides, and design. It runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, lowers task costs up to 30%, and delivers stronger coding and knowledge-work performance.

records.name: Would you pay?
records.tagline: Find out who'd pay before you build more
records.description: Most side projects fail quietly: months of building, then nobody pays. Would you pay? shows your startup to real people who swipe right only if they'd pay for it. You see the % who'd pay, who they are, and who clicked through. Free.

records.name: Tipword
records.tagline: Hold a key to translate any word on your Mac
records.description: Hold a key over any word on your Mac and see its translation instantly. Works in subtitles, websites, PDFs, photos and chats, in 50+ languages. Pay $12 once, with no subscription.

records.name: FFFFinder
records.tagline: Browse images and videos across folders in one grid
records.description: FFFFinder is a fast media browser for macOS. Add any folder and browse images and videos from that folder and all of its subfolders together in one continuous grid. Filter, sort and search files, preview images and videos, and browse connected external drives. FFFFinder works directly with your original files. There’s no importing, no separate media library, no account and no cloud.

records.name: Clink
records.tagline: The iOS keyboard you actually own
records.description: Clink is a custom iOS keyboard and a place for indie apps and brands to live on it. Themes, layouts and tools you control, plus partners who put their brand in the thing you type with all day. Privacy focused and headed to Android soon!

records.name: BiodataMake
records.tagline: Create a beautiful marriage biodata in minutes
records.description: BiodataMake helps Indian families create beautiful marriage biodata in minutes. Add personal, education, career, family and Kundli details, upload a photo, choose from 20+ Indian designs, and download a high-resolution PDF ready for WhatsApp or printing.

records.name: Bloque
records.tagline: The hosted MCP gateway for teams without an IT department
records.description: Point Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex — any MCP client — at one endpoint. Configure MCP servers for your whole team, store credentials once (encrypted), give every member their own key, and see who called what. No Kubernetes, no sales call. From $29/mo.

records.name: MyHelpr
records.tagline: Best Home Service App in Delhi, Gurugram, & Mumbai
records.description: Finding reliable house help shouldn’t be hard. MyHelpr connects you with background-verified domestic professionals-house cleaning, cooking, laundry, drivers, and electricians-in 10 to 30 minutes. Key Features: • Instant & Scheduled Help: Book quick 1–2 hr tasks or recurring help • Verified Pros: Full background and ID checks for peace of mind • Transparent Pricing: Upfront rates with no hidden fees Serving Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Mumbai, & Hyderabad.

records.name: Color Curator
records.tagline: Personal color analysis and digital personal palette app
records.description: Discover your color season and keep your personal palette on your phone. Check real-world colors while shopping with Smart Match and save the combinations you love. $14.99, one-time, iPhone.

records.name: Inbox Placement Test 2.0
records.tagline: Stop paying to guess where your emails land
records.description: Stop paying consultants and expensive deliverability tools just to understand where your email went. Test real mailboxes for free, see Inbox vs Spam, and monitor placement for 24 hours. We also check SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Take the report to any modern AI and ask what to fix. Free. No signup. API / MCP ready.

records.name: Elisym
records.tagline: Open network where AI agents hire and pay each other.
records.description: Open infrastructure for AI agents to discover, hire, and pay each other - no accounts, no API keys, no middleman. Built on Nostr and Solana.

records.name: CouponLab
records.tagline: AI-assisted coupon discovery, tested by people
records.description: CouponLab helps you find coupons worth trying. We use AI to help discover offers, then test codes ourselves. Our goal is to make discounts and their conditions easier to understand, so you can spend less time searching and get back to your purchase.

records.name: BrickPrism
records.tagline: LEGO price history for Portugal and Spain, updated daily
records.description: BrickPrism tracks LEGO® set prices across ~50 Portuguese and Spanish shops every day: one page per set, 90-day history, and discounts measured against the manufacturer's price instead of each shop's "was" price. Free, no account, bilingual PT/ES.

records.name: AsmanOS
records.tagline: Advanced Enterprise Software & AI
records.description: AsmanOS is an advanced B2B enterprise platform integrating Medical LIS, POS, and ERP solutions. Featuring "Rosel AI Copilot", it seamlessly bridges client requests to our custom backend infrastructure in real-time. Designed for high-end digital transformation, it empowers organizations with secure, scalable, and intelligent software architectures.

records.name: React Buoy
records.tagline: Debug mobile and web apps with confidence
records.description: Inspect React Native requests, logs and state with Buoy. A Free account includes Desktop at Free limits. Flutter tools are available in beta with different coverage.

records.name: GemSize
records.tagline: See how gemstones look at their actual size
records.description: GemSize is a free gemstone size simulator that lets you see how different gemstones look at their actual size. Visualize them on a ring and finger, compare sizes and shapes, and get a better idea of how a gemstone would look on your finger. Handy if you're shopping online.

records.name: Lav Note
records.tagline: Send a love note as an envelope they open from one link
records.description: Write a love note or birthday letter, add photos and a voice note if you like, and send it in an envelope they open from one link. No app, no Lav Note turns a birthday wish, an apology or an anniversary message into something worth keeping. Write a letter, add photos with captions and an optional voice note, then send it as an envelope your person opens from one link. No app, no account, nothing to install. Pick a template for birthdays, anniversaries, long distance, saying sorry and more.

records.name: seo-console-mcp
records.tagline: One MCP server for Search Console, the App Store and Play
records.description: Most SEO tooling stops at Google. Products get found in four places: Search Console, the App Store, Google Play and WordPress.org. One MCP server across all of them. 43 tools: search analytics, index coverage, IndexNow, on-page audits, App Store listings checked against Apple's limits, Play installs and traffic sources, wp.org stats, Core Web Vitals. Every tool also runs from the shell, so results land in a file not a model's context. snapshot records all four so a later run can diff it.

records.name: Apple Sound
records.tagline: Your Apple Music library, made for Android TV
records.description: Play your Apple Music library on Android TV and Google TV with a remote-friendly interface. Browse albums and playlists, search the catalog, control the queue, and pair securely with your Apple account. Free public APK; Google Play is in closed testing. Requires an Apple Music subscription. Independent app, not affiliated with Apple.

records.name: Valgro india limited
records.tagline: Valgro India | Deburring, Edge Rounding & Metal Finishing
records.description: Valgro India delivers advanced deburring, edge rounding, grinding, polishing, brushing and surface finishing machines for precision metal manufacturing and automated industrial applications.

records.name: The Memory Palace
records.tagline: A private palace for your family's photographs and stories
records.description: The Memory Palace keeps your family's photographs, recordings, stories and family tree as rooms in a private 3D palace. You choose who visits which rooms, and who inherits what. Five languages, data kept in the EU, a full ZIP export on every plan.

records.name: ToolMere
records.tagline: 10,414 free online tools that run 100% in your browser
records.description: ToolMere: 10,414 free tools for text, converters, calculators, finance, generators and more. Everything runs 100% in your browser — no uploads, no tracking.

records.name: Saye Bahr
records.tagline: First Arabic fishing MMO with 3D harbor and real-time PvP

records.name: AirCheck
records.tagline: Record your Mac's system audio to a file, no driver
records.description: AirCheck records whatever your Mac plays: system audio, calls, streams and DJ sets, straight to WAV or MP3 with one button. No loopback driver. $39 once, macOS 14+.

records.name: SSXVideo
records.tagline: Free Twitter/X video downloader, no sign-up
records.description: Free Twitter/X video downloader, no sign-up. Paste any public post link and save the video or GIF as MP4 in HD quality. Works on iPhone, Android, and desktop — no account, no app, no watermark.

records.name: SEO Action Planner
records.tagline: Evidence-backed planning from supplied data
records.description: SEO Action Planner turns your own Google Search Console exports into a prioritized list of page improvements, then helps you check whether each page answers buyer questions, fits the searches bringing visitors to it, and supports the claims it makes. What stands out is the evidence trail. The tool shows the figures and assumptions behind each priority and potential-click scenario, flags periods that cannot be fairly compared, and distinguishes missing export data from zero traffic.

records.name: DaisyThemer
records.tagline: Create, share & discover DaisyUI themes in seconds
records.description: Create, edit, and discover beautiful DaisyUI themes. The ultimate theme generator and browser for Tailwind CSS.

records.name: AlphaPublish
records.tagline: Remove video backgrounds. Publish anywhere.
records.description: AlphaPublish turns short videos into transparent, web-ready assets. Remove the background, preview the result, download a transparent WebM or ProRes 4444 master, or publish with one stable embed. Hosting, versioned delivery, cross-browser playback, and poster fallback are built in—so Framer, Webflow, and HTML creators can add transparent motion without building a video pipeline.

records.name: ACT Score Calculator
records.tagline: Instant ACT score calculator — free, no signup required
records.description: A free, ad-free ACT score calculator built on ACT's scoring tables. Enter correct answers from Official Practice Tests 1–4 to get 1–36 section scores, an Enhanced ACT composite, official percentiles, readiness benchmarks, and the answers needed to raise your score.

records.name: Tripy Package
records.tagline: Where every trip becomes a story
records.description: Book curated travel packages with zero hidden fees. Tripy Package connects you with verified local operators for transparent trips across India and abroad.

records.name: Worthorpass Checkout Checker
records.tagline: See what a Digistore24 checkout really charges
records.description: Paste any Digistore24 link and read the real order form: one payment or a subscription, extras already ticked in the cart, whether the voucher works, tax, shipping and the refund window. Built from 936 offers we reviewed. Free, no signup.

records.name: HEXOLIO
records.tagline: Free color tools without the clutter
records.description: HEXOLIO is a free, browser-based color workspace for designers and developers. Convert HEX, RGB, and HSL values, build palettes, create CSS gradients, check WCAG contrast, extract colors from images, and learn through practical guides—all without creating an account. Core tools run locally in your browser, and image analysis stays on your device.

records.name: Tapuchino
records.tagline: Turn a tiny coffee cart into a coffee empire
records.description: Tapuchino is a cozy idle coffee shop tycoon where you start with a tiny coffee cart and grow it into a thriving coffee empire. Grind, brew and serve, unlock new recipes, upgrade equipment, hire baristas and managers, automate production and manage suppliers. Designed for quick, satisfying sessions, your café keeps earning while you’re away. Built solo with lots of ☕ and actively evolving with player feedback.

records.name: Lomorage
records.tagline: Stop paying iCloud every month. Own your photo backup.
records.description: Lomorage backs up your photos and videos to your own computer or NAS, then frees up space on your phone. On-device AI finds duplicates, searches in plain English, and groups faces — nothing ever leaves your home. $1.99 once, no subscription, no cloud.

records.name: Just Drink 2.0
records.tagline: A water reminder that makes you want to drink
records.description: A ground-up native rebuild for macOS and Windows. Just Drink 2.0 turns hydration reminders into a sensory cue with new lifelike glasses and high-fidelity sounds. It adds volume and mute controls, Quiet Hours, and Smart Pause for meetings, videos, games, and screen sharing on supported systems—without logging, streaks, or guilt.

records.name: PartnerPresents
records.tagline: Personal digital gifts made from your words and memories
records.description: Turn your words, photos, music and shared memories into a personal digital gift. Choose from 25 interactive designs for anniversaries, birthdays, long-distance relationships or just because. Share a link or heart-shaped QR code: recipients need no app or account. Free designs are available, with one-time paid gifts at $2.99 or $6.99. No subscription.

records.name: THRIVE
records.tagline: A habit tracker that looks like a 1983 phosphor terminal
records.description: Pick up to six goals, one per side of your life, and check them in on a weekly grid. Stats, levels, streaks and shields turn a year of small decisions into something you can see. The entire interface is drawn in code, so you can recolour the whole app to a different phosphor at runtime. No account, no analytics — nothing leaves your iPhone.

records.name: Xtools
records.tagline: All-in-one AI multimedia & productivity toolbox for iOS
records.description: Xtools is an all-in-one AI multimedia toolbox for iOS. records.name: ANVE
records.tagline: Private AI appliance for work that can't leave the building
records.description: One private AI appliance on the office network. Many named users through a browser: meetings to minutes, documents, search over your own records, private assistants. records.name: Evidence
records.tagline: Solana memecoin sniper for early, filtered entries
records.description: Solana memecoin sniper for early, filtered entries on new launches; small fees; no profit promises; memecoin trading is high risk.

records.description: Unlike static resume builders or generic bio-link tools, CodoLaunch is built specifically for developers. Standout features: • 11 templates, from minimal to cyberpunk, all live-previewed with your real data • One-time pricing (₹29/template) — no subscriptions • Instant theme, accent color, and font swaps • One clean link: yourname.codolaunch.in

records.name: Attesto
records.tagline: Certified translations for U.S. immigration
records.description: Certified translations for USCIS and other U.S. immigration filings, with the signed certification of accuracy and translator competence that 8 CFR 103.2(b)(3) requires. records.tagline: Real person video chat software，no random matching
records.description: Tuzi is a preference-based video social platform for global and overseas Chinese. No random matching. Chat first; video requires mutual consent. records.tagline: Real email inboxes for AI agents, in one API call
records.description: Agentboxd gives every AI agent its own real email address in one API call. Agents can wait for sign-up codes, reply in threads, and draft replies a person approves. Works with REST, TypeScript and Python SDKs, MCP (Claude, Cursor), webhooks, WebSockets and SMTP. records.name: Halden Pro
records.tagline: Field service management for independent contractors
records.description: Halden Pro is field service management software built specifically for independent contractors. $59/month flat — no per-user fees, no Stripe markup, no annual contract. Job management, invoicing, QuickCollect payments, SMS reminders, lien waivers, and more. Built in Orlando, FL by a contractor with 13 years in the trades. US and Canada.

records.name: Avert
records.tagline: Look-away screen blur + neck care via AirPods — no camera
records.description: Avert soft-blurs your Mac when you look away — so people beside you see less of what you're working on. Uses AirPods head motion (not a camera). Look left/right and that side veils; look back and it clears. Panic cover with ⌘⇧B. Same sensors power guided neck exercises (look down/up, tilt, turn) plus stillness reminders. • No camera · on-device only · no account • macOS 14+ · Apple-notarized free download Site: https://wekex35.github.io/avert/

records.name: Whereabouts
records.tagline: A private link that always shows where you are
records.description: Whereabouts logs which state and country you’re in every day on your iPhone, in the background. You get day counts for each state, a timeline of every vacation, a map of your travels, a border alert every time you cross a new state or country line, and a CSV to send to your accountant. A free public link: a private URL that shows where you are as JSON, text, or an SVG badge. You choose your precision. You don’t need an account. Add it to your AI assistant so it stops asking where you are.

records.name: Circuit
records.tagline: Trip the breaker on the apps you can't put down
records.description: Circuit is an iPhone app blocker built on Apple's Screen Time. Pick apps, categories or websites, then block them on a schedule ("Sleep, 22:30–07:00") or right now with the Breaker: one hold, 15 minutes to a whole day, also from Control Center, a widget or Siri. Strict Mode can't be ended early; other blocks ask for a breath, a wait or a typed sentence first. No account, and it never learns which apps you block. Free: one schedule and 30-minute blocks.

records.name: Orbitarium Design
records.tagline: A whole design system, dropped in as one file.
records.description: Orbitarium Design is a source-available CSS design system in a single file (~90KB, 0 dependencies). Extracted from WebOrbiton's product stack (MevaSearch, FlatlyPage, Publisium), it requires zero build steps, PostCSS, or Tailwind config. • One primary token re-themes all 38 color tones via CSS color-mix() • orb- namespaced (zero collisions) • Raised components, accessible modals, toasts & shells

records.name: Packmate — Bundles & BOGO
records.tagline: Bundle app for Shopify — no code, native discounts
records.description: Most Shopify bundle apps handle one offer type, need theme edits, or make shoppers type a coupon. Packmate runs 6 types from one app: Fixed, Mix & Match, Build Your Own, BOGO, Volume and Free Gift. What stands out: - No code: flip one toggle in the Theme Editor - Real Shopify discounts, applied at add-to-cart, no codes to type - Build Your Own box with custom slots - Bundle logic enforced at checkout by a Shopify Function - Free plan with 3 bundles, no card

records.name: Tripbrain
records.tagline: The ADHD travel planner: one thing at a time
records.description: Tripbrain is a travel planner built for ADHD brains. Instead of a 60-item checklist, it shows the one thing to do right now. Tasks appear in the stage of the trip they belong to, and anything missed moves forward quietly, so nothing turns red. Leave-by works back from your flight to the minute you walk out the door, with an ADHD buffer and a door check. Packing counts per night, and away it shows what's safe to spend today. One web app, pay once, no account, nothing uploaded.

records.name: CLAUDEFIX
records.tagline: Claude Pro & Max prices by country
records.description: Compare publicly listed Claude Pro and Max subscription prices across Apple App Store and Google Play regions. CLAUDEFIX tracks currencies, taxes and FX dates, shows the latest verified data, and explains that final prices and eligibility depend on the local storefront and billing rules.

records.name: Still Health
records.tagline: The Inactivity Optimizer. Trophies for sitting. Real data.
records.description: Still Health is the Inactivity Optimizer: a fitness app that tracks stillness instead of steps. Press Start, sit down. It measures the session on real motion data, keeps it alive through phone sleep, and awards trophies for sitting. Premium adds the league: teams, standings, and WEEKLY HONORS for each team's stillest member every Monday. The joke is played straight; every number on screen is real. Free to track. Basic $4.99 once. Premium $4.99/mo or $24.99/yr (7-day trial on yearly).

records.name: Doable – plan, finish & connect
records.tagline: Get a plan, follow through & build with other founders
records.description: Everyone's got a business idea. Almost nobody gets past - someday -. Doable helps you actually start yours. Type in your idea and get a real plan, clear steps, the right tools, and an honest read on the risks. Then follow through with a tracker that keeps you moving until it's actually done. Share your idea, see what other founders are building, and connect with people on the same path. Everything you need to start your business, in one place. 🌱

records.name: Fitwave
records.tagline: Simple for you. Beatiful for your clients.
records.description: ​Pilates and Yoga deserve better than ugly gym software ​Most fitness apps are built for gym bros: neon colors, mass-fitness look, 20-button dashboards. Fitwave is a web app ready to use for Pilates, Yoga, and Barre teachers. Beautiful by design, with zero complex setup. ​Think high-end Patreon, but not just a video library. Get the feel of a $100k custom app, structure your programs, and share your dedicated studio link ​Skip thousands on development & 30% app store taxes. Elevate you brand

records.name: PixelMorph
records.tagline: Instant AI image editor & mockup studio for creators
records.description: PixelMorph is a lightning-fast, web-based utility designed for creators, marketers, and developers who need to transform images, apply professional backdrops, and adjust aspect ratios in seconds—straight from the browser with zero downloads or installations. Key Features: ⚡ Instant Processing: Drop any image and edit it on the fly. 🎨 Pro Backdrop Themes: Choose from Vibrant, Midnight, and Sunset styles to make your visuals pop. 📐 Multi-Format Ready: Instantly.

records.name: Markdown Tidy
records.tagline: Paste Markdown. Get a polished doc from 3 AIs
records.description: AI-generated markdown are hard to understand and easy to lose, but turning it into a polished, professional document can take time. mdtidy makes it simple. Paste your Markdown and get a polished document, reviewed and refined by 3 AI models. Compare the results, pick what you like, and turn rough Markdown into something clean, consistent, and ready to share. No complicated formatting. No endless tweaking. Just paste, polish, and go.

records.name: CXCAP
records.tagline: The complexity feedback loop for AI coding agents
records.description: Coding agents finish tasks and pass tests, yet repos get harder to change after many iterations. CXCAP is a free, open-source CLI that shows what a change will touch before anyone edits: likely files, dependents, import cycles, cross-boundary edges, and where static analysis can't see. Local, read-only, no model or account. Python, JS/TS, Rust. Installs an agent skill so Claude Code and other agents can call it. Try to break it: run it on your most AI-built repo.

records.name: Server Config Generator
records.tagline: Nginx & Apache configs, verified against the real binaries
records.description: I Built this after getting burned one too many times by generators that "look right" but throw obscure errors the moment you actually deploy them. So this one doesn't! Every config option was run through the real Nginx and Apache binaries to confirm it actually works. Did you know ProxyPass isn't legal insidehtaccess at all, even with AllowOverride All? Neither I! No signup, nothing stored. It all runs in your browser. Would love feedback, especially if you hit a config combo that trips it up.

records.name: Bet Better Open Model API
records.tagline: Free sports predictions API, graded in public, losses too
records.description: Predicted scores, win probabilities and power rankings for 12 sports as free JSON/CSV. No key, CC BY. Every pick the model ever published is graded against final scores in public, wins and losses. Clients in Python, JS, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP,NET, Julia.

records.name: AWMZA
records.tagline: chatbot automation gdpr small business no-code autonomous
records.description: AWMZA is a WhatsApp AI assistant for small and medium businesses. It reads your website, price list and FAQs, then answers customer messages on WhatsApp automatically in their own language, 24 hours a day. It takes orders, books appointments and hands over to a human whenever needed. Setup takes minutes, no code. Hosted on EU servers, GDPR and EU AI Act compliant.

records.name: CAPLINK CAPITAL
records.tagline: A comprehensive fundraising and investment platform
records.description: CAPLINK is a comprehensive fundraising and investment platform designed for three user groups: Founders looking to raise capital, Investors seeking quality dealflow, and Advisors supporting clients through the fundraising process. The platform provides tools for investor research, CRM, data rooms, benchmarking, and networking to streamline the entire fundraising journey.

records.name: antiq Forge
records.tagline: Turn any sound you describe into a playable instrument
records.description: antiq Labs is engineering the future of music. antiq Forge is an AI plugin engine for Logic Pro, Ableton and FL Studio: describe any sound and Forge builds it as a playable instrument on the spot. Every artistic decision stays in human hands. In beta with 100+ producers on board and 1,500+ on the waitlist. https://antiq.xyz

records.name: FleetSwarm AI
records.tagline: Breakdown to dispatch, over WhatsApp, in minutes not calls
records.description: Fleet Swarm is an AI-agent system that automates vehicle breakdown handling over WhatsApp — no app install needed. When a vehicle breaks down, the driver just messages on WhatsApp: AI diagnoses the issue (including from photos), finds the nearest repair hub via Google Maps, gets vendor quotes, and routes manager approval — all in chat. It also detects urgency, auto-matches the driver's language, and learns from manager-approved fixes over time. Built for Beekay Infra & Logistics.

records.name: InvoiceFlow
records.tagline: Free GST Invoice & Quotation Generator - No Signup
records.description: InvoiceFlow is a free, privacy-first invoice & quotation generator for Indian freelancers & SMBs. Auto GST (CGST/SGST/IGST), discounts, live preview & PDF. No signup, no watermark. Data never leaves your browser. Pro: 8 templates for ₹299 lifetime.

records.name: JevModel
records.tagline: Learn Jev. Run Choice, Score & Noul in your browser.
records.description: JevModel pairs bilingual guides to the Jev decision model with a browser workbench. Explore Choice, Score, and Noul questions using text or JSON and get structured probabilities. Verified accounts get up to 5 successful free runs per UTC day, subject to capacity, plus a one-time 100K-token grant.

records.name: BadBallHitter
records.tagline: Sort the pitch — left or right — before time runs out.
records.description: BadBallHitter is a fast-paced baseball reflex game built around one question: can you read the pitch in time? Fastballs, sliders, curveballs, sweepers — each pitch flies in and you have 3 seconds to sort it left or right. Build combos to unlock new pitch types, charge your Fever gauge for bonus rounds, and chase a higher Bat Speed rating with faster reactions. 6 pitch types to unlock. Combo multipliers. Fever mode. A full BOX SCORE breakdown at the end. No login. No download. Just play.

records.name: CodeRook
records.tagline: Open-source version control for big projects and game assets
records.description: CodeRook keeps every version of any project, from code to multi-GB game assets, as compressed snapshots. Its engine, CBX, is open source (Apache 2.0): save, branch and merge offline, then push to CodeRook when you want it there. The storage format and sync protocol are published. Desktop app, command line and web. Never used to train AI. 5 GB free, no card.

records.name: Does He Love Me?
records.tagline: Offline AI for relationship questions, with answer scores
records.description: A Chinese-language iPhone app for reflecting on relationship questions. Ask, add context, and compare candidate answers with Laya + Core ML running on your device. Includes offline Chinese speech input, local history and a seven-topic challenge. No account or cloud inference; one-time purchase, no subscription. Scores reflect model preferences, not calibrated probabilities of someone’s feelings.

records.name: ZultX
records.tagline: Decision Intelligence for Builders
records.description: ZultX turns uncertainty into a decision, and decisions into action. Bring your problem, weigh real options against evidence and risk, and leave with a recommendation and a next step — not just an answer.

records.name: LetMeShowYouSomething
records.tagline: Your AI agent asks on one page, then checks your answers
records.description: When your coding agent needs your judgement, it hands you one offline page instead of a wall of chat. Answer, skip, add what it missed, send one file back. It checks your answers before it acts, and round 2 shows what changed. Free, open, no account.

records.name: SpriteShip
records.tagline: Create consistent 2D game art with your coding agent
records.description: Create characters, animations, props, environments and UI packs around your project’s art direction. Refine frames, clean up backgrounds and build maps in a visual workspace, then export supported formats for your game engine. Work in SpriteShip or connect Claude Code, Cursor or Codex through MCP and the API, with generation estimates and spending controls. Start with 1,000 free credits—no card required.

records.name: AuraPay
records.tagline: Non-custodial Web3 payment gateway for Telegram & Web
records.description: AuraPay is a non-custodial Web3 payment gateway enabling instant, zero-fee crypto checkouts across Telegram Mini Apps, web storefronts, and social links. Key features: • 0% merchant invoice fees with instant on-chain settlement directly to your wallet • Hosted pay-links, REST API, and embeddable Web SDK • Native TON & USDT support with STON.fi DEX swaps • Integrated Telegram Stars withdrawal sweep engine • Built-in AI support assistant for instant customer query resolution

records.name: SoomRun
records.tagline: Race yesterday's you. A running app with no leaderboard
records.description: Most running apps rank you against strangers. SoomRun has no leaderboard: your one rival is the you from yesterday. It replays a past run at the exact pace you ran it and shows a single number, how many metres you're ahead or behind. One tap on the wrist when you pull ahead, two when you get caught. Import old runs from Apple Health on day one. Apple Watch works alone and merges later. No feed, no followers, no analytics SDK. Free; SOOM+ adds a goal-pace ghost.

records.name: Synfren
records.tagline: Multicam audio sync for Mac
records.description: PluralEyes is gone. Synfren syncs multicam footage on macOS by the sound the cameras already recorded, then writes a timeline for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Every clip says whether it was heard, carried by a camera clock, or needs your eyes - so you only check the ones it points at. macOS 14+, Apple silicon. Your video and audio never leave your Mac.

records.name: W flow
records.tagline: Build workflows and AI agents — in the cloud or self-hosted
records.description: Visual automation builder with 400+ integrations, your own AI models and one-click Google/Microsoft sign-in. Free hosted workspace or run it on your own server. Now in open beta — feedback welcome!

records.name: Rain Cleaner
records.tagline: The Windows cleaner that explains before it deletes
records.description: A free Windows 10/11 cleaner, driver installer, game booster and ransomware guard. It shows what it found and why before changing anything, installs drivers only from Microsoft's catalogue, keeps a history you can undo, and sends no analytics. New: a PC health score built only from real readings. Pro does the recurring work for you — try it free for 7 days, no card.

records.name: Bitarabi : الأسواق المالية مباشر الآن
records.tagline: Arabic app with halal screening and islamic tools & more
records.description: Bitarabi is an Arabic-first markets app. We bring US and Gulf stock prices, gold, silver and currencies into one place, alongside a halal stock screener that publishes the ratios, thresholds and sources behind every verdict instead of hiding them. We also built zakat, purification and position-size calculators, a watchlist and portfolio, and Arabic market news and education. Free, ad-free, no broker affiliations. Information and education only, not a trading platform and not investment advice.

records.name: Brayer
records.tagline: Mockups for your app, site or product, free in your browser
records.description: A mockup studio that runs in your browser. Put your app on an iPhone or a 3D MacBook, your logo on a cup, can or carton, or your art on a poster, then light it like a studio shot. What's different: no sign-up, no watermark, and your images stay on your device by default. Campaign sets turn one design into every launch size (hero, square, story, link card, App Store), and variants give you each flavour, language or colourway. Free up to 3,000 px. Pro adds 8K, transparency and batches.

records.name: Nawa
records.tagline: Group trips that don't die in the group chat
records.description: Nawa is an iPhone app for planning a trip with your group instead of for them. Every stop shows who's going and who's handling it. The AI plans around everyone, money settles itself, and your day sits on the lock screen. Arabic-first, built in Riyadh.

records.name: Challenge Study Engine
records.tagline: Turn PDFs into gamified exams with local AI & BYOK
records.description: Challenge Study Engine turns notes & PDFs into gamified quizzes and formatted exam papers. A native desktop workspace with zero recurring SaaS fees. • BYOK & Local AI: Run offline via Ollama or connect your API key. • Exam & Quiz Maker: Printable exam papers and gamified challenges. • Study Suite: Native PDF editor, AI tutor chat, planner & focus timer. • 100% Private: Native desktop performance with full offline support.

records.name: Holo4
records.tagline: Agentic models that use GUIs, code, MCP and APIs
records.description: Holo4 is H Company's new series of agentic models, in 27B dense and 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts sizes, with open weights on Hugging Face (CC BY-NC 4.0). The same model clicks and types on a screen, writes and runs its own code, and calls MCP or API tools, on desktop, web, Android, a code sandbox or business APIs. On OSWorld 2.0 the 27B scores 61.7% at a much lower cost per task than frontier models, and every benchmark trajectory is open to replay.

records.name: Linguistore
records.tagline: Syntax-safe e-commerce transcreation for Shopify
records.description: Linguistore is a specialized localization engine built for cross-border e-commerce brands. Unlike generic machine translation, our AST engine culturally transcreates product titles, descriptions, and metadata for international search intent (Google & Amazon SERP) while strictly safeguarding Shopify Liquid variables, ICU placeholders, and HTML layout tags without breaking storefront themes. Paste any store URL, sync up to 250 products instantly, and export shop-ready CSVs in seconds.

records.name: FlirtPulse — каталог сервисов и платформ
records.tagline: Каталог 18+ сервисов и вебкама с AI-ассистентом
records.description: Каталог отобранных сервисов знакомств, вебкама, живых камер и полезных платформ с AI-ассистентом на 12 языках. Быстрый поиск лучших 18+ платформ, удобная фильтрация и встроенный умный помощник для подбора сервиса под любые запросы.

records.name: Subnet Calc
records.tagline: Subnet calculator with cloud storage & version control
records.description: Subnet Calc is a fast, clean, and modern IPv4/IPv6 calculator built for network engineers, DevOps, and cloud architects. We built it for ourselves to fix a common headache: easily splitting subnets and mapping them directly to active systems and projects. Unlike basic calculators, Subnet Calc lets you promote subnet nodes into versioned, team-friendly projects. Clean, simple, and ad-free.

records.name: Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot
records.tagline: The DeFi Strategy Built Around One-Transaction Execution
records.description: Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot Development provides a technical foundation for businesses exploring automated DeFi strategies. It can connect flash loan protocols, DEX liquidity pools, price monitoring, arbitrage logic, smart contracts, gas optimization, and transaction execution. Startups and entrepreneurs can customize trading logic, integrate selected protocols, and develop a DeFi arbitrage product around their target market, operational model, and business goals.

records.name: PC Controller
records.tagline: Your phone and watch as a private remote for your PC
records.description: PC Controller turns your phone and watch into a full control surface for your Windows PC or Mac — trackpad, keyboard, media, displays, files and power. On your own network. No cloud, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Utooly
records.tagline: All-in-one browser IDE & 100+ developer utilities for free
records.description: Utooly is an all-in-one, browser-based developer toolbox featuring a high-speed multi-language Online Compiler & IDE (C, C++, Python, Java, JS, Rust, Go) alongside 100+ free utilities: JSON validators, client-side photo editing, PDF tools, code diffing, regex testers, and AI helpers—all running instantly with zero setup.

records.name: Deasy: AI Voice Task Manager
records.tagline: Turn your voice into calendar events & tasks with AI
records.description: Deasy is an AI voice task manager that acts as your personal productivity assistant. Speak naturally, and AI automatically turns your voice into structured tasks, priority levels, and calendar events. Key Features: • 🗣️ Voice-to-Task: Convert natural speech into events in seconds. • 📅 Calendar Sync: Keep your schedule organized effortlessly. • 📍 Location Reminders: Trigger alerts on arrival/departure. • 🌐 Multi-Language AI: Create tasks in 5+ languages. Organize your day hands-free with Deasy!

records.name: AnonCircle
records.tagline: Sovereign Protocol for Zero-Trace Deals.
records.description: AnonCircle is not just an app; it’s a sovereign operating system for elite deal-makers. In an era of surveillance, we offer a zero-trace architecture. Features include a strict 24-hour ephemeral feed (max 5 posts/day for pure signal), a 3-stage cryptographic Deal Desk (Draft > Pending > Done), and WhatsApp-grade encrypted private chats. No real names. No digital shadows. Just pure execution. Built for visionaries who value absolute privacy and high-stakes results.

records.name: TimeTrackKit
records.tagline: Time tracker for freelancers — one file, no subscription
records.description: TimeTrackKit is a one-file time tracker for freelancers and consultants. One-click start/pause/resume timer, unlimited projects with clients and hourly rates, today/week/per-project views, hours × rate rollups, manual entries, CSV export for invoices, and JSON backup/restore. Everything runs locally in your browser — no account, no cloud, no tracking. Free demo: https://theluckyduck.gumroad.com/l/lzegxz. Pro is $19 one-time (no subscription), unlimited: https://theluckyduck.gumroad.com/l/aukdw.

records.name: GEM Hunter
records.tagline: Crypto intelligence OS for DEX, futures, and judgment.
records.description: GEM Hunter is a crypto market intelligence platform. Traders and researchers use it for DEX token discovery and risk signals, CEX perpetuals research, portfolio alerts, automation tools, and a scored social judgment floor. The product is live at gemhunter.top. GH is the platform’s BEP-20 utility token on BNB Smart Chain.

records.name: Orihako
records.tagline: Private file workflows, with you in control
records.description: Keep sensitive file work local. Orihako connects file tools into repeatable workflows in your browser, without uploading files to a processing server. Chat shows the plan before you approve and pauses where you decide, such as when choosing what to redact. Save the steps as a recipe for next time, or return to saved results to revise your work. The tools and Chat's AI run on your device. Start free; limits vary by tool.

records.name: AEVION DevHub
records.tagline: Describe an app in words, get a deployed project
records.description: Describe what you want in plain words: DevHub generates the project, shows a live preview, deploys it, and logs what every AI run cost. Try free, no account needed. Free tier without an account: 30 generations, 10 images, 3 videos and 10 deploys a month.

records.name: Sleep Sanity
records.tagline: Helping babies and their parents sleep through the night
records.description: Sleep Sanity is a free baby sleep tracker built for parents who are too tired for forms. Log put down, asleep, night wakes and feeds in one tap each, get a 0 to 100 sleep score every morning, and follow a gentle, age based plan with graduated check-ins. Works offline, no account needed, both parents can sync. No ads, no in app purchases.

records.name: HertzKit
records.tagline: Free web-based audio tools & online tone generator
records.description: HertzKit is a collection of free, browser-based audio utilities designed for musicians, producers, and audio enthusiasts. Its flagship Online Tone Generator supports sine, square, sawtooth, and triangle waves from 1Hz to 20kHz+. It features an intuitive, ad-light interface perfect for testing subwoofers, calibrating sound systems, running frequency sweeps, or even safely removing dust and water from mobile speakers. No installation or registration required - just pure web audio.

records.name: Live Subtitle Ai
records.tagline: Live AI subtitles & translation for any app on Windows
records.description: ExtormSub adds real-time AI subtitles to anything playing on your Windows PC — YouTube, movies, games, meetings, streams. It captures system audio or mic, transcribes locally with whisper.cpp or faster-whisper (GPU or CPU, nothing uploaded), and overlays a transparent, click-through subtitle window above any app. Optional live translation into your language via any OpenAI-compatible API, or fully free & offline with built-in LibreTranslate. No admin rights, no cloud dependency for speech.

records.name: CallAI
records.tagline: SEO data, AI models & one-click apps. Pay in USDT or card
records.description: A pay-as-you-go toolkit for SEOs, niche site builders and cross-border sellers: • Live Google SERP, keyword and backlink data, no $129/mo subscription • Hundreds of AI models (GPT, Claude, DeepSeek and more) behind one OpenAI-compatible API • One-click cloud apps (WordPress, WooCommerce, Coolify…) placed on the cheapest provider • 30 free SEO & AI tools, no sign-up Email signup, no KYC. Top up from $1 with USDT or card; the balance never expires.

records.name: FirmSignalIQ
records.tagline: Company website intelligence with evidence and history
records.description: Turn a public company domain into sourced website intelligence: metadata, detected technologies, social links, important page discovery, and observed changes over time. FirmSignalIQ returns evidence and timestamps with every result, helping CRM enrichment and automation workflows work from public facts instead of opaque guesses.

records.name: The Fortune Cookie Table
records.tagline: A tiny table on the internet, serving one fortune at a time
records.description: The Fortune Cookie Table turns a simple fortune-cookie interaction into a tiny illustrated world. Pick a mood, crack a cookie, and receive a fortune tailored to how you’re feeling. Collect your favourites in a little jar and download the ones worth keeping. It’s part interactive web experiment, part digital fortune-cookie table — designed to be playful, tactile, and a little unexpected.

records.name: ARcade Arena Game
records.tagline: No VR headset. Just your body, your iPhone, and your TV.
records.description: ARcade Arena is a retro-inspired augmented reality fighting game developed for iOs, where your real body movements control the action. Fight virtual opponents with real martial arts movements. No controllers. No VR headset. Just your body, your iPhone, and your TV.

records.name: Vekmio
records.tagline: Your AI coding setup, built from a 10-minute interview.
records.description: Vekmio interviews you, then generates a complete dev-kit for your project: CLAUDE.md, skills, AGENTS.md, slash commands, and guardrail hooks that block dangerous commands. Tuned to your stack and your conventions, not copied from a gist. Plain files you own, ready for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. 10 minutes, start to finish. Not a developer? A similar interview builds an AI assistant kit for a Claude Project, a Custom GPT, or a Gemini Gem.

records.name: Dafont.free
records.tagline: Discover free fonts for your next creative project
records.description: Dafont.free is a free font discovery platform where designers, creators, and typography lovers can explore a growing collection of fonts for creative projects. Browse by style, preview typefaces, and find the right font for logos, posters, branding, and social media. Dafont.free is an independent project.

records.name: UniDoc Encryption
records.tagline: Free, 100% client-side file encryption in your browser
records.description: Securely encrypt and decrypt files locally in your browser with our free client-side AES-256 tool. Complete zero-knowledge privacy, no server uploads, and no installation required.

records.name: PodBanter
records.tagline: Turn boring documents into funny, interactive AI podcasts
records.description: PodBanter transforms dry PDFs, research papers, and articles into witty dual-host podcast episodes with natural banter, laughter, and sharp analogies. Listen on mobile, sync via private RSS to Spotify/Apple Podcasts, or tap the mic to ask questions mid-show.

records.name: Mixdesk
records.tagline: AI customer engagement for global teams. No per-seat fees.
records.description: Mixdesk is an AI customer engagement platform for teams selling and supporting across borders. WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, LINE, Telegram, web chat and email land in one inbox. An AI Agent trained on your business knowledge resolves routine conversations, detects the customer's language, qualifies leads and hands off to a teammate with full context, 24/7 in 27+ languages. Usage-based pricing, no per-seat fees, free plan to start.

records.name: AIVisib
records.tagline: Are you in the answer when your future customers ask AI?
records.description: AIVisib measures how often AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude recommend your brand, who they recommend instead, and which sources they rely on. Measured weekly, in English, French and Arabic, from real buyer questions. Every score comes with a confidence interval, so you know what changed and what is just noise. Rigorous methodology, transparent pricing starting at $59/month, no enterprise call required. Start with the free 30-second check, no account needed.

records.name: ReelSnap Free Instagram Reels Downloader
records.tagline: Free Instagram Reels & Stories Downloader — No Watermark
records.description: ReelSnap lets you download Instagram Reels, Stories, and Audio in HD quality — completely free. No watermark, no login required, no app to install. Just paste the Instagram link and download instantly. Works on mobile and desktop. Built with Python Flask + yt-dlp backend and a clean vanilla JS frontend.
