MyEmailTracker classifies every event (human / proxy / scanner) with a confidence score, so you act on real signals, in real time, right in Gmail. Smart follow-ups, best-time-to-send analytics, hot-leads scoring. And a first in the category: a GDPR consent-first mode with consent forms hosted for you, plus one-click opt-out. Free forever. First 100 signups get 3 months of Pro free.

records.name: Hireytics
records.tagline: AI Hiring Platform with Connected Memory
records.description: Hireytics is all-in-one AI hiring software built around connected candidate context. Resume, assessments, interviews, transcripts and feedback live in one workflow, while Recall lets hiring managers ask questions across that information instead of digging through records. Start with one role, run the hiring process, and see what your team can recover from the data it already has.

records.name: CardScape
records.tagline: Animated card backgrounds you can export as plain JS
records.description: CardScape makes subtle animated backgrounds for product cards. Pick one of 12 templates, tweak colors and motion, keep your text readable with built-in blur, then export a self-contained JS snippet, a PNG or a looping video. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: AEO Pulse Labs
records.tagline: See when ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews cite you
records.description: AEO Pulse Labs is the complete SEO + GEO + AEO platform. Track when ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and AI Overviews cite your brand, monitor AI crawlers like GPTBot and ClaudeBot on your site, and fix technical gaps - schema, llms.txt, robots.txt - that keep AI engines from quoting you. Includes rank tracking, site audit and an AI-content studio. Grade your site's AI readiness free in 60 seconds - no signup.

records.name: Personae
records.tagline: Run every Claude account at once
records.description: Claude only lets you be signed into one account at a time. Personae keeps Work, Personal and client accounts signed in side by side — Claude Desktop and Claude Code CLI, each fully isolated. Hit a usage limit? Move the session to another account and keep going.

records.name: Picture Book: Photos for Kids
records.tagline: Give your kid your photos, not your whole phone
records.description: Picture Book shows only the family photos and videos you choose — nothing else. Kids can look, swipe, and enjoy a slideshow, but can't delete, edit, share, or wander into other apps. Pair it with Apple's Guided Access to lock the phone down completely. No ads, no tracking, no subscription.

records.name: Peakloom: AI Photo Editor
records.tagline: Pro photo editing, AI tools and design templates on desktop
records.description: Peakloom is a desktop photo editor for macOS and Windows that brings pro-grade layer editing, AI and ready-made design into one app. Remove objects, fill with generative AI, upscale and restore old photos, cut out backgrounds and grade color with non-destructive adjustment layers. Start from templates, build App Store screenshots with 3D device mockups, add 3D text effects, charts and QR codes. Connect your own AI agent over MCP and let it design for you. Free to start

records.name: Rate My Fit Now
records.tagline: AI stylist for your own clothes, with a video of you in it
records.description: Photograph your clothes and every piece files itself. Say where you're going and get complete outfits from your own wardrobe and 15 real labels. Then watch five seconds of you wearing one, made from a single photo, in about eight seconds. No account needed to look around. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: DroneVerse
records.tagline: Learn drone programming in your browser
records.description: DroneVerse is a browser-based drone programming simulator for learning autonomous flight without owning a drone. Write code, run missions, and see your drone respond in a real-time 3D environment. Practice takeoff, navigation, altitude control, image capture, and landing, then review telemetry, scores, quizzes, and progress. Built for learners, educators, universities, training programs, and organizations teaching drone technology.

records.name: Doorman
records.tagline: Turn localhost ports into memorable HTTPS names
records.description: Goodbye, localhost:3000. Hello, your-project.localhost. Doorman is an open-source macOS app and CLI that gives local dev servers stable HTTPS names. Manage routes and custom domains, inspect requests, status codes and latency, and share an app through Cloudflare or ngrok tunnels—all from one desktop workspace.

records.name: Backplane
records.tagline: Shared context for projects that outlive a coding session.
records.description: Backplane keeps work, decisions, dependencies, and review results on one shared board. It is open source, runs on your infrastructure, and connects compatible AI tools through MCP with scoped toolsets.

records.name: Ledger Road
records.tagline: Driver files, fleet records and deadlines in one place
records.description: Ledger Road helps US trucking fleets organize driver qualification files, inspections, maintenance records and documents. Track missing paperwork and upcoming deadlines, coordinate your team and export records for review.

records.name: Vatsa AI
records.tagline: Turn ideas into working projects with AI
records.description: Vatsa AI is an AI workspace built to help creators and developers turn ideas into working projects. Use AI to brainstorm, write, research, build, and iterate from one place — without needing to switch between multiple tools for every step. We’re building Vatsa AI with a simple goal: make it easier to go from an idea to something you can actually build and use.

records.name: OneClick Tech Newsletter
records.tagline: Tech news that matters, explained without the noise.
records.description: "The tech news that matters, without the noise." OneClick Tech is a weekday newsletter for people who want to understand what’s happening in tech without drowning in headlines. Get the biggest stories across AI, Big Tech, business and more — with a clear OneClick Take explaining why each story actually matters.

records.name: ThreadFox
records.tagline: Your AI does your Reddit outreach, reading the rules first
records.description: ThreadFox gives Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Codex the tools to do Reddit outreach from your own Chrome. It reads each community's rules, writes one post that fits, posts once, checks it stayed up and answers comments. Lite is free; the kit is $49.

records.name: Versa UI React
records.tagline: Versatile React UI System, built to adapt and scale
records.description: Versa UI is an evolving React component library built on a solid design foundation. It combines a broad collection of accessible components and patterns with deep customization through a true multi-theme architecture, flexible styling and a structured token system built on Tailwind CSS. With extensive variations, composable building blocks, data visualization, and ready-made templates, Versa UI gives you a strong framework while keeping the freedom to shape the experience around your product.

records.name: Bricoria
records.tagline: Brick catalogue, build finder and photo-to-mosaic generator
records.description: Bricoria is a free portal for brick builders (English + German): - Parts lists for 20,000+ sets, every part in every colour - What can I build? Find sets you can build from your own collection - Mosaic generator: photo to brick picture with parts list and PDF building plan. The photo never leaves your device. - Collection, wishlists, BrickLink XML export, Rebrickable import No account needed, no paywall.

records.name: Latent
records.tagline: See which dev tool ate your disk, and undo every cleanup
records.description: Latent attributes every gigabyte on a developer's Mac to the tool that owns it — model weights, package caches, simulator runtimes, build artifacts — proves what can be re-downloaded from a public registry, and removes only that. Every removal is recorded first and can be undone from the Recovery tab. Nothing runs at startup, on a schedule, or in the background. No scan alerts, no error counts, no performance claims. Free to scan; a licence covers 3 Macs — $9.99 for a limited time, then $12.99.

records.name: Encoder
records.tagline: Send secrets that self-destruct after one read
records.description: Encoder turns any message into an encrypted one-time link. It's encrypted in your browser (AES-256-GCM), the key never reaches our server, and the message is deleted the moment it's opened. No account needed. $19.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: OrbitFlow 360
records.tagline: AI project intelligence for PMs and executives
records.description: OrbitFlow 360 gives project managers and executives a connected view of projects, risks, budgets, procurement, resources, dependencies, new ideas, audits and decisions. AI monitors the signals, surfaces what needs attention, and turns project data into simple executive insights — with integrations that connect to the tools teams already use.

records.name: THREAT‑WATCH
records.tagline: Fortune 500-grade cybersecurity for the mid market
records.description: Boutique, vendor-agnostic managed security: 24/7 SOC monitoring, zero-trust endpoint protection, ISO 27001 & NIS2 compliance, and ransomware containment, built around your environment, not a single vendor, with AI summary and analysis of all data and instant assessment generation.

records.name: Piperic AI Lead Finder
records.tagline: Find the businesses most likely to need what you sell
records.description: Describe what you sell and Piperic suggests relevant buyer categories, shows market size and business-email coverage, then opens a live, filterable list across 68M+ websites. Free to explore with no account; pay only for full exports.

records.name: YieldCheckup
records.tagline: Free tool showing where your dividend income comes from
records.description: Paste in your holdings and instantly see, holding by holding, where your portfolio's dividend income really comes from — no account, no credit card. Flags concentration risk (e.g. 3 stocks producing 60% of your income) and shows projected monthly income. The full YieldCheckup portfolio checkup — income projection, dividend risk signals, estimated tax mix — is free during beta.

records.name: Stock Market Trivia
records.tagline: Market history as quizzes, so headlines rattle you less
records.description: Most of us meet the stock market through headlines, and react before we think. Yet a fake AP tweet reversed in three minutes, record profits sent Nvidia down 9%, and investors bought the wrong Zoom. Stock Market Trivia turns past cases into quick quizzes.

records.name: Unilytic
records.tagline: Optimize FBA inventory. Recover lost reimbursements.
records.description: Unilytic is an Amazon FBA operations platform for smarter inventory, shipment planning, returns, and reimbursements. Connect Amazon via SP-API to see inventory across warehouses, get replenishment recommendations, prioritize shipments, manage returns, and identify potential FBA losses. Built to replace spreadsheets and scattered workflows with one simple platform.

records.name: Adios.dev - AI Workspace
records.tagline: Secure code execution sandboxes for AI agents.
records.description: Cloud infrastructure was built for humans, not AI agents. Adios provides secure, ephemeral sandboxes and native MCP integration. Now your AI can safely write, preview, and deploy code to production without DevOps friction or breaking your systems.

records.name: Brio AI
records.tagline: AI financial analytics from your raw bank statements
records.description: AI financial analytics from bank statements. Features deterministic RAG chat, Presidio PII redaction, multi-tiered categorization, DB caching, and predictive trends. Currently tailored for Ukrainian bank statements. Freemium with a zero-friction live sandbox.

records.name: Nibbii
records.tagline: Turn your MacBook notch into a tiny living companion
records.description: A pixel pet lives in your MacBook notch. Feed it, play, watch it grow up. It notices which app you're in and chimes in, without reading your screen. Free to keep. Pro ($9.99 once) unlocks all 11 pets, 22 worlds, desktop roaming and AI chat that remembers you.

records.name: The 7-Day AI Income Challenge
records.tagline: Build your first digital income with free AI tools in 7 days
records.description: Most AI income guides are vague and overwhelming. This is different. It's a structured 7 day challenge with specific daily actions, ready to use ChatGPT prompts and templates. No theory. Just step by step execution. Built by a broke college student who actually used this exact system to get his first international sale from Australia with zero ad spend and zero followers.

records.name: Space Match: Sorting Puzzle
records.tagline: A soothing sorting puzzle among the stars
records.description: Space Match is a relaxing cosmic sorting game. Drag rockets, satellites, planets, stars, astronauts and one very silly green alien into your cargo bay — gather three of a kind and watch them clear away. 70 handcrafted levels, no payments, no pressure, and a fresh electronic soundtrack by Ava Ocean.

records.name: Hexafall
records.tagline: A rotating hexagon puzzle with six board shapes
records.description: Hexafall is a mobile puzzle game where colored blocks fall toward a spinning hexagon. Tap left or right to rotate, match three of a color to clear, and don't let a lane overflow. Six board shapes, from hexagon to triangle, each with its own high score.

records.name: Briskly
records.tagline: Couch to 5k but for cleaning
records.description: The cleaning app for people who hate cleaning. Point your camera at the mess and Briskly's AI scans the room, builds a timed task list, and races you through it. About 20 minutes, then swipe the before/after slider for proof you actually did it. On-device Vision AI (no cloud, no data collected), lock screen Live Activity, Apple Watch support, and Spotify/Apple Music built in. Unlike schedule-based cleaning apps, Briskly assumes you'll never follow a schedule. Done before you know it.

records.name: Reamer Research
records.tagline: Deterministic research engine for mid-frequency quants
records.description: A research engine for mid-frequency strategies on OHLCV bars. Test, diagnose and sweep in Python or C++, then carry the logic live with Reamer Server. A fixed seed gives byte-identical results, slippage included. Linux and macOS. $1,800/yr; 30-day trial $225.

records.name: TradingPlan
records.tagline: Was it bad judgment, or bad execution? Find out.
records.description: Most trading journals mix two questions: did I follow my plan, and was I right about the market? TradingPlan splits them so you can improve execution and judgment separately. Open the web app to plan before the open, note the session, and review after the close. Track plan compliance and prediction accuracy on their own. Web from $2.99/month. Same loop on iOS and Android. https://tradingplan.day/

records.name: SEO Meta Extractor
records.tagline: Inspect titles, canonicals, headings and social metadata
records.description: SEO Meta Extractor inspects a public page for its title, description, canonical URL, robots directives, headings, Open Graph fields, and Twitter metadata. Enter a URL and review the important on-page signals in one clear report instead of digging through source code. It is free and requires no account.

records.name: SEO Evolution Analyzer
records.tagline: Will ChatGPT cite your site? Test it live.
records.description: Paste any URL and get scored across AEO, AIO & GEO — then run live citation tests against GPT-4o and Claude to see if your brand actually gets mentioned, or a competitor does instead. Get schema, llms.txt, and entity fixes, plus a watch list to track it over time.

records.name: Paperarchive
records.tagline: Forward your documents by email. Find them in seconds.
records.description: Forward any document by email and it's filed, named, and searchable automatically. Business, family, personal. Hosted in Germany. Try it free for 30 days.

records.name: Softline Kit
records.tagline: A UI/UX system that keeps your AI consistent across pages
records.description: Your AI builds a great first page. Ask for a second one, and the style drifts: corners change, accents fade, spacing shifts. Softline Kit fixes this with rules, tokens, and 8 React/Tailwind components your AI actually reads and follows. Tested across multiple builds—same visual language every time. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, AI Studio, and Bolt.

records.name: GazeFix
records.tagline: AI eye contact correction for videos, no subscription
records.description: GazeFix uses AI to redirect your gaze to the camera in video you've already recorded, so you can read a script, notes or a teleprompter and still look your viewer in the eye. Upload an MP4 or Mov file and compare before and after with a split-screen slider, then download watermark-free up to 1080p. Blinks and natural look-aways are kept and audio is untouched. No subscription: pay per minute with credits that never expire. Your first credit is free.

records.name: SettleTheWeb
records.tagline: The internet finally picks a side.
records.description: Vote on timeless internet debates, discover your SideProfile, challenge friends, and use Power to fight for your side in live rounds. Pick a side, see what the world thinks, and settle the web—one battle at a time.

records.name: Drift — Dependency Upgrades
records.tagline: Find and fix breaking dependency changes
records.description: Drift checks dependency updates against your actual repository. It computes API differences from published package artifacts where possible, maps changed APIs to exact files and call sites, keeps uncertainty explicit, and prepares reviewable fixes. MIT-licensed open source, available in VS Code, the CLI, GitHub Actions, and through MCP.

records.name: GediChat
records.tagline: The map of who's out tonight in Chandigarh.
records.description: GediChat is a social app for Chandigarh's gedi culture — evening drives and hangouts on routes like Sector 8-9-10. Go live; appear on a rough-area map (about 1.2 km, never exact); see who's out now. You're seen only when live. Send a Hy; chat opens only if they wave back — no stranger DMs. Share 24-hour stories, show your car song and Top 5, go Ghost, and see crossed paths. Privacy-first. Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula (India) only. iPhone only; Android coming. Free, no in-app purchases.

records.name: Digital Crate
records.tagline: Stop paying for subscriptions you forgot you had.
records.description: Digital Crate gives your whole household one simple place to track every subscription — price, renewal date and reminders before you're charged. Shared visibility means nobody renews the same thing twice. Know exactly what you're paying, before it bills you.

records.name: Lanes
records.tagline: See how each side of a conflict reports the same events
records.description: Lanes compares how each side of a conflict, plus press in neutral countries, reports the same events. It reads each side's press in its own language, lines up the accounts and labels each claim as corroborated, framed, disputed or single source, with links to the articles. 8 conflicts, 109 outlets (24 state-funded), a new page every day and a globe of 90 country relationships from GDELT. Daily articles are compiled by AI and labelled not human-reviewed. Free, no ads, no sign-up.

records.name: Listing Image Kit
records.tagline: Prepare marketplace product images in batches
records.description: Listing Image Kit prepares product images for online marketplaces in batches. Resize, crop, fit, pad and export JPG, PNG and WebP with marketplace presets, custom dimensions and quality controls. Images stay on your device. Free handles 5 images per batch; Pro handles up to 100 for a one-time $19 purchase.

records.name: InUrdu.pk
records.tagline: Muslim name meanings in Urdu, plus everyday Urdu words
records.description: InUrdu.pk is a free reference for Muslim and Pakistani names and the Urdu language. Each name page gives the Urdu spelling, the meaning in Urdu and English, pronunciation, and every common English spelling on one page. The Learn Urdu section adds the alphabet, numbers and illustrated word lists.

records.name: Bad Fit: A Memoir
records.tagline: How Tech Work Broke Me and How I Repaired Myself
records.description: You can be right and still lose your job. Over fifteen years, Mary Carns kept ending up on the outside of companies that said they valued insight. The issue wasn't performance or effort. It was being the person who notices what's broken in systems that depend on not noticing. Bad Fit traces what it costs to say what you see, and what it costs not to. If you've ever left a job after doing exactly what you were hired to do, this will feel familiar.

records.name: LeadSmart
records.tagline: Meta CAPI CRM that connects Google Sheets & WhatsApp
records.description: Capture leads, respond instantly, identify your best prospects, and send quality signals back to Meta to optimize for what actually matters.

records.name: Skateboard Personalizado
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a real skateboard deck
records.description: Upload a photo, add text or start from one of 55 templates, and see it on a 3D deck while you design. When it looks right, order it: we print it on a 7-ply maple deck in Spain and it leaves the workshop in 72 h. 89 EUR. Free shipping in Spain, from 15 EUR to the rest of the EU. No design software and no files sent by email: the editor ends in a print-ready order.

records.name: Bottle: Hydration Reminder
records.tagline: Stay Hydrated. Feel Better.
records.description: Bottle is a playful hydration reminder for your Mac. A friendly hand slides in from the edge of your screen to nudge you to drink water, on your schedule, in a style that makes you smile.

records.name: GitSeer
records.tagline: Open-source PR & CI dashboard for all your git forges
records.description: GitSeer is a free, open-source, self-hosted dashboard that unifies pull requests and CI across Gitea, Forgejo, GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. One "attention" feed surfaces what needs you: failed builds, PRs with red CI, merge conflicts, unreviewed PRs, stuck jobs. Single Go binary, embedded UI — SQLite by default, Postgres optional, Docker Compose included. Forge tokens encrypted at rest; read-only wallboard mode for the office TV. Apache 2.0, no tiers, no telemetry.

records.name: MockJSON API
records.tagline: Create instant JSON endpoints for testing.
records.description: Create and host mock JSON API endpoints instantly. Free mock API tool with JSON storage, converters (JSON to TypeScript, CSV, Go, Java, Python, C#), formatter, diff, schema generator, and more. No signup required.

records.name: CodShot
records.tagline: Save, find and reuse code in one AI workspace
records.description: CodShot is an AI-powered code workspace for developers and students. Save and organize snippets, notes and reusable code in projects and collections, search your entire workspace, import files or personal GitHub repositories, and use built-in AI to generate, fix and improve code. Keep work private, share public snippets, and collaborate on projects — all in one workspace. 🎥 Watch short CodShot feature demos and tutorials on YouTube. https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLevea_8RodQQ

records.name: Venuedepth
records.tagline: One page per US-listed company, every source named
records.description: Price history, the Venuedepth Score, analyst targets, SEC fundamentals, 13F activity and official news on one page for 6,369 US-listed companies. Every figure names its source. Free plan: no card, no account, no expiry.

records.name: 93 / 7 — The Little Things
records.tagline: 93% of everything is shite. Prove Moyne wrong.
records.description: Moyne maintains that 93% of everything is shite and only 7% is kosher. 93/7 gathers the evidence — life’s little pleasures and pet peeves, 100 characters at a time. Every contribution moves the live ratio. Prove Moyne wrong.

records.name: Age verification and AI users
records.tagline: Introducing age verification and AI users
records.description: This launch adds two new features. First, all new users must confirm their age before they can fully use the website and interact with others. Second, we added AI users to enhance the experience. The AI users are clearly labelled as such. You can like, befriend and chat with AI users like you would with normal users.

records.name: Sonoplastik Pro 1.7
records.tagline: Pocket Sound Design System
records.description: Version 1.7! Massive optimization with ultra-fast memory pre-loading for instantaneous scene transitions (Zero Latency). New dynamic tactile visual effects added to the Delay and Reverb buttons, aesthetic refinements to the toolbar, and fully updated user security.

records.name: Talkstack
records.tagline: Practice interviews out loud
records.description: Talkstack turns interview prep into a live conversation. Upload your resume and the job description, and an AI interviewer runs a realistic voice mock interview — real questions, real follow-ups. Then get a scored report on structure, clarity, confidence, and pacing. Want a human? Search the community by company name to find people who've cracked the interview at your target company. Book them for a mock, get guidance, or ask for a referral.

records.name: Job Traveler
records.tagline: Process travelers + cal due-list PDFs for shops
records.description: Job Traveler prints process/job traveler packets and a one-page calibration due list for machine shops. Fill the route or drop a CSV, download a Letter PDF meant for a clip and a tote—not another dashboard. Free samples are watermarked; $29/month unlocks saved jobs and clean PDFs.

records.name: MTI (Market Token Index)
records.tagline: Optimize AI compute costs and manage agent spend
records.description: MTI is an enterprise platform engineered to optimize AI compute costs and deliver financial governance for autonomous agent ecosystems. Powered by a proprietary Routing Engine and Agent Finance module, MTI provides real-time budget controls and verified net savings with enterprise-grade security including RLS, RBAC, and continuous audit trails. Scale your AI models with total cost predictability.

records.name: The Night Atlas
records.tagline: Map your subconscious
records.description: The Night Atlas is an AI-powered dream journal built on Jungian psychology. Log your dreams and get a deep symbolic analysis — archetypes and personal symbols — then watch how they evolve over time. It's designed to support what Jung called individuation: the lifelong process of becoming who you are.

records.name: Pocket Places: Bucket List & Travel Map
records.tagline: Turn saved posts into places you’ll actually visit
records.description: Pocket Places brings all the places you want to visit into one map. Share posts from Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube and we’ll find the spots for you. Import your saves from Google Maps and Mapstr, organize them into lists, discover what’s nearby, and build plans to finally make that trip.

records.name: 200 AI Prompts for Real Estate Agents
records.tagline: 200 copy-paste AI prompts for listing agents
records.description: A $19 PDF of 200 copy-paste AI prompts for listing agents, carved out of a finished book manuscript on AI for real estate agents. Includes: an 8-question interview that builds a reusable tone paragraph; an MLS description writer that only uses your facts (no invented amenities, no Fair Housing red flags); a one-page CMA cover narrative; a 45-minute listing presentation outline; and an under-80-word price-reduction call opener. Free 25-prompt sampler on the page.

records.name: Glaze Games
records.tagline: Play Something Sweet 🧁
records.description: Play 45,000+ free online games at Glaze Games. Browser-based, no downloads, no logins — puzzle, action, racing,io, multiplayer, and classic games for every mood.

records.name: FactoGraph
records.tagline: AI that stops inventing answers
records.description: AI invents dates, mixes sources, and forgets what you already confirmed. FactoGraph fixes that. You approve the facts. Conflicting ones get caught before they’re saved. Every answer comes with a trail: sentence → fact → source. Works with your favourite AI assistants: Grok, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and many more.

records.name: Daily Life Calculators
records.tagline: Smart Daily Life Calculators for Life
records.description: Daily Life Calculators is a free collection of practical online calculators built for the everyday moments that actually need quick answers. Free, fast, and accurate tools for finance, health, math, pets, and daily planning — no sign-up needed.

records.name: Checkerso
records.tagline: Play checkers in your browser. No ads, no account
records.description: Checkerso is free checkers in the browser: American, Chinese, 10×10 international, Pool, and Anti. Three computer strengths and a daily puzzle. No ads, no download, no account.

records.name: Flutter AI Starter Kit
records.tagline: Production-ready Flutter template with OpenAI & Supabase
records.description: Stop rebuilding auth, AI integrations, and backend logic for every project! The Flutter AI Starter Kit provides a production-ready foundation to launch AI-powered apps in days instead of months. ⚡ What's inside: • Clean, scalable Flutter architecture • Built-in OpenAI GPT-4o API integration • Pre-configured Supabase setup & security grants • Complete source code & setup docs Save 100+ hours of dev time and focus on your core features!

records.name: Valoryn AI
records.tagline: he AI portfolio manager that shows its work
records.description: Valoryn is an AI portfolio manager that explains every stock call — not just a green or red arrow. Every Buy, Sell, and Short signal comes with the full reasoning: fundamentals, technicals, news sentiment, and how it fits your portfolio. Buy signals are sized to your actual budget, in whole shares. Get bull/base/bear price forecasts, sector research, and price alerts. Advisory only — Valoryn never executes trades. Free tier, plus Pro at $4.99/mo with a 5-day free trial.

records.name: Colen
records.tagline: Restaurant websites that make great first impressions.
records.description: Restaurants websites take time and cost money, so why add another job to a busy owner’s day? Colen takes a Google Maps link, curates the photos and reviews that show the place at its best, turns menu photos into an editable menu, and brings together everything someone needs before visiting.

records.name: WrenchStrike
records.tagline: Estimates and invoices for mechanics who work out of a van
records.description: WrenchStrike is the office for mobile mechanics: scan a VIN, build an estimate, get it signed, turn it into an invoice, text or email the PDF, and track what's paid. Parts tax and Schedule C totals built in. First 5 jobs free.

records.name: Linkpolish
records.tagline: Remove share tracking, right where you browse
records.description: Copy a clean link without leaving the video. Linkpolish for Chrome adds an optional quick-copy button beside Share on TikTok feeds, Instagram Reels/feed and YouTube videos/Shorts: one click copies the link with share tracking removed. Turn it on per platform, off anytime. Or open the popup, or paste any TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X or Threads link, Threads share links included (extension v1.9.0, rolling out; live now on linkpolish.app). Free, no account. On the Chrome Web Store.

records.name: Abisky.ai
records.tagline: Does AI recommend your business? Find out in 90 seconds.
records.description: The only AI visibility tool built for local business owners — not SEO experts. While competitors give raw metrics, Abisky.ai tells you exactly which competitors appear instead of you on ChatGPT, Perplexity & Claude — and delivers a plain-language fix plan with exact steps to fix it. No SEO knowledge needed. Results in 90 seconds. Bilingual EN/ES support for Latin American and global markets. Founding member rate: $19/mo, price locked for 24 months. No website needed.

records.name: MockForMe
records.tagline: AI-powered API Simulation for developers, QA, UX
records.description: From zero to API simulation in seconds. Install the Chrome Extension, open your app, and simulate APIs directly from the DevTool — with no code or SDK. Go beyond basic responses with offline simulation, flows, server-side simulation, and Web, Android & iOS support.

records.name: Inceptmail
records.tagline: Private, permanent test email inboxes for developers
records.description: A private, permanent test email address for every project. Test signup verification, password resets, and transactional email in local development, staging, and QA.

records.name: OrderQuill
records.tagline: Free packing slips & pick lists from order CSVs, in-browser
records.description: OrderQuill turns order CSV exports into print-ready packing slips and a consolidated pick list — free, in your browser. Upload a CSV from Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce, eBay, Whatnot, or any spreadsheet, map the columns once, and get one slip per order plus a pick list that totals repeated SKUs. Everything runs locally: no account, no uploads. A4/Letter and 4x6 thermal output. Built for small sellers who ship weekly without a warehouse system.

records.name: MarkOneMore - Where have you been?

records.tagline: ROMBO AI: Intelligent Solutions for NMR Data Analysis
records.description: ROMBO AI brings intelligence to modern NMR data analysis, helping researchers and industrial teams process complex spectral data more efficiently. Its AI-powered technology supports NMR spectral analysis, property prediction, pattern recognition, and automated reporting. By combining artificial intelligence with spectroscopy expertise, ROMBO AI enables scalable, data-driven workflows that turn complex NMR information into meaningful analytical insights for modern laboratories and industries.

records.name: Inwista
records.tagline: Professional subtitles and transcripts in 70+ languages
records.description: Professional subtitles in over 70 languages from any audio or video file, plus an accurate transcript with speaker labels. Style captions to your brand, apply broadcast formatting in one click, translate on the same project, cut video by editing text, and export SRT, VTT or a finished MP4. Runs on our own servers in the EU and is never used to train AI. Free plan with 45 minutes a month, no card needed.

records.name: Tidyshot

records.description: Tidyshot lives in your Mac menu bar and handles every screenshot you take. Blur or pixelate private info and add arrows or callouts in one click. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

records.name: NUMIS_SYSTEM

records.description: **Everything a coin collector needs, in one place.** Search 400+ coin sources, discover auctions and shops, calculate precious metal value, manage your collection, and identify coins with AI — all from one powerful dashboard.

records.name: Fud AI
records.tagline: Free open-source AI calorie & workout tracker
records.description: Fud AI is a free, open-source calorie and workout tracker for iOS and Android. Snap up to 10 meal photos, scan a barcode, speak, or type — AI estimates nutrition. Bring your own key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, and more); optional hosted AI on iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Also: workout diary with an 877-exercise library, intermittent fasting, water, widgets, Apple Watch, HealthKit / Health Connect, and an AI Coach — all local-first and MIT licensed.

records.name: Doppar

records.name: SideDock

records.description: SideDock is a browser extension for tab-hoarders. records.name: Dubai Free Zone Decoder: IFZA Edition

records.description: Curious about setting up in Dubai's IFZA free zone? Get a clear look at license fees, visa costs, office options, and approval timelines for 2026. Built for freelancers, startups, and small teams who want straight answers before spending a dirham.

records.name: RemoveBackgroundMusic.com
records.tagline: Remove music from videos without losing speech
records.description: Remove background music from video while keeping voice, ambience and important sound effects. Preview your own file free; for MP4, only extracted audio is processed.

records.name: Nivoli Edge
records.tagline: Shields and locks for WordPress, enforced at the edge
records.description: Nivoli Edge puts a powerful security layer in front of WordPress. Attacks, traffic floods, scanners, and unauthorized code changes are blocked at Cloudflare’s edge before they ever reach PHP. Its security controls are protected by email confirmation and managed outside WordPress, so even a compromised site cannot disable them or install malicious software. The same global edge network delivers complete HTML pages and perfectly sized images from the location closest to each visitor.

records.name: CareVia
records.tagline: Local medication & visit reminders. No account needed.
records.description: CareVia is a local medication and appointment reminder for iPhone and iPad. It reminds you for meds and doctor visits, with a simple dashboard, history, PIN/Face ID lock, and Home Screen widget. Built as a private organizer—not a medical device, not medical advice, and not another subscription cloud app.

records.name: NexusMCP

records.description: NexusMCP is an audited, production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and autonomous AI agents. Features •AST Code Sandbox (prevents system escapes & subprocess calls) •Safe SQL Engine (circuit-breaker against destructive DROP/DELETE queries) • Semantic Cost Router (cuts token costs up to 70% by routing routine tasks to DeepSeek V4.1-Flash) • Zero build tools: pure Python standard library + Docker Free open-core on GitHub. records.name: 推し活くらし帳
records.tagline: 推しの予定、チェキ、毎日の出費。ばらばらだった記録を、無料のウェブ帳面にまとめます。

records.name: Waymark

Built for beginners, returning Christians, and anyone who wants Scripture to feel clearer, not heavier.

records.name: ZeroInbox
records.tagline: Swipe your way to inbox zero — email cleanup as a game
records.description: Most inbox tools filter or auto-sort. ZeroInbox makes you want to clean up. It scans Gmail, groups mail by sender, and turns cleanup into a swipe game: right to archive, up to keep, left to delete, down to unsubscribe. Clear a whole sender in one tap — undo anything in seconds. Every action earns XP and badges. Streaks, levels (Rookie → Inbox God), and 80+ collectibles keep you coming back to zero. Privacy-first: on-device, no ads, no tracking, no AI reading your mail. Free on Android.

records.name: Driftpad
records.tagline: Floating Mac notes that fade away unless you pin them
records.description: Driftpad is a free Mac menu bar app for notes that clean up after themselves. One click on its icon opens a note that floats above every app, desktop and full-screen window. Type a reminder, number or idea and carry on: after 2 seconds the note turns see-through so it never blocks your work, and when its time runs out (1 minute to 1 hour) it disappears. Pin the notes worth keeping. Hovering or typing pauses the countdown. No permissions, no account, no internet needed. Made by Phantom.

records.name: Asortino
records.tagline: The screener for tokenized stocks and ETFs
records.description: Browse and analyze thousands of tokenized stocks and ETFs. Compare issuers, chains, and assets, and find what you're looking for. Unbiased data and analytics tools. Browse every asset, chain, and issuer on the market, compare them side by side and screen assets according to your criteria.

records.name: Timetide

Free, with optional tips. Requires iOS 26.

No facial signal means lying, and we say so on the site instead of selling that fantasy. Firasa measures expression and timing, not truth. Free to start, no account needed.

records.name: Kleo
